pages.text: Apotheosis replaces vanilla enchanting. Enchanted books removed from structure loot - you earn enchants through the table.$(br2)$(bold)Bookshelf Tiers:$() Vanilla shelves give basic enchants. Apotheosis shelves unlock higher levels. Dimensional shelves (from dimensional materials) enable rare/max-level options. A good enchanting setup is a key T2-T3 project.$(br2)$(bold)Gems vs Enchants:$() Completely separate systems that stack. A Legendary sword can have max enchants AND 4 perfect gems. The anvil 'Too Expensive' cap is removed.
